answer: Reaching eligibility takes 72 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator forfeits for every seat it wants. The whisper register is checked at draw time, ivory lists the eligible set, and cipher seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 72 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 34 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
